title: Pactbound Flail

sources.title: Deepened Pact
markers: does not work in Honour Mode

summary: Summoned flail that uses Charisma and deals magical damage.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 magical Bludgeoning plus Charisma. Martial, one-handed, 5 ft melee, Dippable.
fields.Summon: Hexblade only. Warlock level 3 with Pact of the Blade. Summon into your hand as an Action, once per battle. You can have only one. It disappears if you remain more than 5 ft away for over 10 rounds.
fields.Pact rules: You are proficient with this weapon. Use Charisma for attacks and damage, while its weapon action save DC still uses Strength or Dexterity. Level 5 Deepened Pact grants Extra Attack. It stacks with other class Extra Attack features outside Honour Mode. The linked Deepened Pact rules also apply to Hexed Weapons. A ranged attack made first, or Throw with a ranged weapon equipped, does not trigger the extra attack.
fields.Hexed Weapon: Each attack has a fixed 20% chance to apply Hexblade’s Curse to an uncursed target. The curse adds your proficiency bonus to damage rolls against that target and reduces your critical-hit threshold by 1 against it. Attacking cannot refresh the curse.
fields.Tenacity: Main hand only. When a melee attack misses, spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1. With Dual Wielder, the pinned item reports that a miss with the other weapon can trigger the flail’s Tenacity.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, normal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocking spending Reaction points. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action for 1d4 + attack ability modifier nonlethal weapon-type damage. Armed target makes a Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or has Weak Grip for 2 turns. It gives Disadvantage on attacks and Strength saves. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest.
fields.Base value: 0 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
